info.name: ScheduCal API v1
info.description:
Complete API collection for ScheduCal calendar scheduling service.

## Authentication
All customer endpoints require `apiKey` and `apiSecret` in the request body.

## New Features (December 2025)
- `gmailFirstInvite` field in Create and Invite responses indicates first-time Gmail user priming

## Response Format
All responses follow this structure:
```json
{
  "success": true|false,
  "message": "Human readable message",
  "data": { ... },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

request.description:
Create a new calendar appointment with optional initial invitee.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| apiKey | string | Yes | Your API key |
| apiSecret | string | Yes | Your API secret |
| appointmentSubject | string | No | Subject/title |
| appointmentBody | string | No | HTML body content |
| appointmentStart | string | Yes | ISO 8601 start time |
| appointmentEnd | string | Yes | ISO 8601 end time |
| appointmentTimeZone | string | Yes | Time zone |
| appointmentLocation | string | No | Location |
| name | string | No | Initial invitee name |
| address | string | No | Initial invitee email |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Appointment created successfully",
  "data": {
    "appointmentId": "AAMkAGI2...",
    "subject": "Team Meeting",
    "start": "2024-01-15T10:00:00",
    "end": "2024-01-15T11:00:00",
    "timeZone": "America/Los_Angeles",
    "location": "Conference Room A",
    "inviteeCount": 1,
    "hasInitialInvitee": true,
    "gmailFirstInvite": true,
    "dateCreated": "2024-01-10T15:30:00Z"
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

### gmailFirstInvite Field
When `true`, indicates this is the first invitation to a Gmail-hosted email from your account. The invitee may need to check spam or approve adding to calendar.

item.name: Webhook Management
item.description: Register and manage webhook endpoints to receive real-time notifications about appointment events.

request.description:
Register a webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| apiKey | string | Yes | Your API key |
| apiSecret | string | Yes | Your API secret |
| webhookUrl | string | Yes | HTTPS URL to receive webhooks |
| eventTypes | array | Yes | Events to subscribe to |

## Event Types
| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `attendee.responded` | Attendee accepts, declines, or tentatively accepts |
| `attendee.proposed_new_time` | Attendee proposes alternate time |
| `appointment.updated` | Appointment time/location/subject changed |
| `appointment.canceled` | Appointment deleted |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Webhook registered successfully",
  "data": {
    "webhookId": "49856464-9c29-43b0-ad45-a8a9812d82bf",
    "secret": "whsec_abc123...",
    "webhookUrl": "https://your-server.com/webhook",
    "eventTypes": ["attendee.responded", "appointment.updated", "appointment.canceled"]
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

**Important:** Save the `secret` for signature verification. It cannot be retrieved later.

Update webhook configuration.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| apiKey | string | Yes | Your API key |
| apiSecret | string | Yes | Your API secret |
| eventTypes | array | No | Updated event subscriptions |
| isActive | boolean | No | Enable/disable webhook |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Webhook updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "webhookId": "49856464-9c29-43b0-ad45-a8a9812d82bf",
    "eventTypes": ["attendee.responded"],
    "isActive": true
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

Delete a registered webhook.

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Webhook deleted successfully",
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

Regenerate the HMAC signing secret for a webhook. Use this if you suspect the secret has been compromised.

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Webhook secret regenerated",
  "data": {
    "webhookId": "49856464-9c29-43b0-ad45-a8a9812d82bf",
    "secret": "whsec_newSecret123..."
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

**Important:** After regenerating, update your server to use the new secret immediately. The old secret will no longer work.
